verdict: GBP visibility dropped sharply this week; overdue milestones are being resolved now.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — your Google Business Profile activity fell 84–92% in the last seven days, with actions dropping to zero across the group for September 7–10; this is a sustained visibility pullback, not a single-day anomaly, and the team is actively investigating the cause. Paid channels are not running at this time, making organic local search the sole source of inbound engagement. In the last 28 days, your combined Google Business Profiles delivered 329 total actions across all three entities (14 calls, 201 directions, and 114 web clicks). A set of foundational CRM, SEO, and outreach milestones that were due by July 31 and August 31 remain open; clearing these unlocks the downstream pipeline and email work planned for this quarter. Resolution of the open blockers and restoration of profile visibility are the two priorities in motion heading into next week.
